summary: Iteration 11 — Full validation of dynamic column detection + sample_rows diagnostics in the scraper (backend code-level + frontend rendering). Backend: 22/22 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_scraper_playwright_fix.py (17 existing regression + 5 new TestDetectColumns code-level checks). All regressions confirmed: test-connection with fake creds → ok=false + 'Giriş başarısız' + debug_screenshot; 1-day backfill fake creds → days=1/ok_count=0/fail_count=1 with per-day debug_screenshot; validation 400s (invalid start, end<start, range>62); list/get/put endpoints unchanged; debug PNG endpoint serves image/png with auth + rejects .txt and path traversal. New code-level assertions verify: (a) _detect_columns is defined as async function; (b) it returns dict with keys headers/provider/method/tur/status/amount/created; (c) it reads from 'thead th'; (d) _extract_table_rows calls _detect_columns and uses cols['provider'..'created'] dict lookup — no hardcoded cells[2..9] anywhere; (e) _extract_table_rows returns headers/column_map/sample_rows in addition to rows/total_seen/newest_date/oldest_date/pages_visited; (f) AdminScraper.jsx renders 'Tablo yapısı (debug)' <details> block with headers + column_map + sample_rows. Frontend: /admin/scraper loads (admin-scraper-page), nav-admin-scraper works, Etobahis accordion expands showing all 4 action buttons (test-connection/run-now/backfill/save). Toplu Çekim dialog opens with defaults start='2026-08-01' and end=yesterday ('2026-08-06'). Executed a real 1-day backfill (2026-08-06→2026-08-06) with fake creds — result panel renders '0 / 1 gün başarılı · 1 hata', per-day row shows date + '✗ Giriş başarısız — kimlik bilgileri hatalı olabilir veya captcha var' + working screenshot link ('https://gaming-ledger-pro.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/scraper/debug/scrape_fail_35285197.png'). No rendering crashes with null diagnostics on failed days (the debug <details> section is conditional on r.diagnostics.deposits?.headers so it's correctly omitted). Cleanup done: scraper_configs Etobahis reset to enabled=false, username='', password_enc unset. Preserved: base_url + 6 mappings + last_run_summary blob.

critical_code_review_comments: scraper.py:_detect_columns — Uses substring match on lowercased header text; if the source ever adds a column like 'Ödeme Yöntemi' (contains 'yöntem'), it may shadow the real 'Yöntem' column (both would match). Consider exact-match first, then substring fallback. Non-blocking for current source layout.

scraper.py:284-288 — sample_rows collection loop `while len(sample_rows) < 3 and row_data:` uses row_data[len(sample_rows)] which is fine on first page, but on subsequent pages if the first page had <3 rows this may pull rows from later pages. Behavior is acceptable (still 'first 3 rows seen') but could be confusing when debugging. Consider capping at 3 on first page only.

scraper.py:295-300 — cols.get('provider') is not None AND cols['provider'] < len(cells) — defensively skips when column not detected. Good. However if _detect_columns returns None for a critical column (e.g. 'created' missing), every row silently drops with no diagnostic warning. Consider logging a warning + surfacing missing critical columns in diagnostics.

AdminScraper.jsx:568-586 — Diagnostics summary shows only deposits.headers/column_map/sample_rows in the debug <details>. If deposits and withdrawals tables have different column orders, admin only sees deposits. Consider a second <details> for withdrawals or a single toggle showing both. Minor polish.

Server.py failure path still returns no diagnostics field (only debug_screenshot + error). Frontend already handles this with optional chaining but consider explicit 'diagnostics: null' for schema consistency (carry-over review from iter 10).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Scraper dynamic column detection is production-ready. Verified: _detect_columns async function maps Turkish/English header text to logical column indices; _extract_table_rows uses this map (no hardcoded indices); diagnostics dict includes headers/column_map/sample_rows/total_seen/newest_date/oldest_date/pages_visited/rows; frontend renders 'Tablo yapısı (debug)' <details> block for successful days. Frontend key selectors unchanged from iter 10 report. Real E2E verification with true source credentials still not possible — user should perform 1 real-cred backfill on a day known to have transactions and verify diagnostics.deposits.headers matches the source table's <th> texts and column_map integer indices point to the correct columns. To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_scraper_playwright_fix.py -v` (~67s). localStorage token key is 'pst_token' (not 'token').
rca_of_the_issue: Original 2026-08-01 zero-row bug had two contributing factors: (a) source-side pagination limited to 10 rows × N pages, addressed in iter 10 by _try_set_page_size_100 + max_pages=100; (b) hardcoded column indices (cells[9] for Oluşturulma) that didn't match the actual source table's column order — this is what iter 11 fixes. New _detect_columns dynamically maps column names → indices at runtime by reading <th> texts. sample_rows + headers + column_map in diagnostics let admins see EXACTLY what the source returned when a scrape yields 0 rows, so any future column-order changes can be diagnosed at a glance. Code-level tests confirm the plumbing but true validation requires a real-cred run on a day with known transaction volume — recommend main agent perform this final verification.
